messages:
Marta K.: Bringing up llama-2-13b-int8 on a dedicated pool (g5-16). Seeing intermittent OOMs during bursts when responses > 400 tokens. `max_new_tokens` default is 1024 in model-config. Anyone seen fragmentation causing OOMs with int8?

Ryan L.: Yep, ran into similar. Memory fragmentation with mixed-size batches + long sequences. Two quick fixes: preallocate KV cache per-request and set slab allocator to reuse. Also reduce default `max_new_tokens` to 512.

Sasha I.: Can you paste model config? Also are you using continuous batching? That tends to produce uneven shapes and fragmentation.

Marta K.: config snippet: ```json
{"model":"llama-2-13b-int8","max_new_tokens":1024,"batching":{"enabled":true,"max_batch_size":8},"runtime":{"allocator":"default"}}
``` We do continuous batching with target latency 120ms.

Priya S.: Try `allocator: jemalloc` + `prealloc_kv: true` and `batch_pad_to_max_seq: true` in runtime config. Padding reduces fragmentation at cost of token waste, but it's predictable.

Dan W.: Another trick: cap `batch_max_total_tokens` so one long request can't blow up a batch. Example in runtime: `batch_max_total_tokens: 4096`. That prevents 2x long requests from pairing.

infra-bot: Canary deploy started for config change `reduce_max_to_512_v1` on pool redwood-ded-13b-int8.

Ryan L.: Also ran quant tests — int8 had a small quality drop on our eval suite vs fp16 (~1.3% metric delta), int4 looked significantly worse. For cost vs quality, int8 + allocator tweaks is the sweet spot.

Marta K.: After setting `max_new_tokens`=512 and `prealloc_kv: true` OOMs dropped to 0 in a 24h canary, p95 latency rose ~+12ms. Throughput improved slightly due to fewer OOM retries. Will keep monitoring.

Sasha I.: Can we log per-request allocation stats? Add a flag `--log-mem-alloc` to runtime to capture fragmentation events and the largest contiguous free block when an OOM occurs.

Priya S.: Also note we should update model catalog docs: default `max_new_tokens` per-model profile for int8 models = 512 and recommended runtime flags: `prealloc_kv`, `jemalloc`, `batch_pad_to_max_seq`.

Dan W.: I'll open a follow-up PR to change the model catalog default and add a nightly regression that simulates mixed long+short requests to catch fragmentation/OOM patterns.

Marta K.: Thanks all :thumbsup: saved the rollout.
